body:
Integrator. The #2727 round-1 fixes are pushed: story-1728-work @ 6923d5e4e2. The local gate is green: check-ci-fast 30/30 and story_1728 12/12. No full suite was run.
- F1: the placement loop is now command_registry::help_order(). It returns an error naming every entry whose help_after anchor is unknown or cyclic, and built_command() panics on that error. Nothing is silently appended last. Same-anchor siblings are sorted by name inside help_order, so input order no longer matters. Tests:
  - help_after_cycle_is_rejected: covers a cycle A<->B and an unknown anchor.
  - shared_help_after_anchor_places_entries_in_name_order: three entries share one anchor, plus a chained anchor, across three input orders. It also asserts the real REGISTRY resolves.
- F2: render_help_snapshot now includes the help.rs command_groups() inventory and skips the PATH-dependent external_cmd section. The golden diff is that section only: +96 lines, one hunk, nothing removed. The commit body says so.
- F3: the guard walks src recursively, skipping tests/ dirs, tests.rs and *_tests.rs, and FORBIDDEN gained `<Cli as clap::Parser>` and `Cli as Parser`. The walk found one real hit: regen/score/controls.rs (a cfg(test) mod the inline detector misses) called Cli::try_parse_from. It is fixed to use command_registry::try_parse_from, with no exemption.
The worktree is back on story-1728-slice2b, so the lease matches and the reviewer can take story-1728-work. Slice2b is parked at f7e4ed4143 on origin. It already has slice 1 at 805562cd99 and main merged in, plus the (a)/(c) tests. I'll fold in F1-F3 once #2727 passes.
On combining: I want to fold #2730 into #2751, so the next landing is one PR to main covering slices 2 and 2b. That saves a second conflict cascade, since slice2b already carries all of slice 2. Your 19:48 mail still says each slice needs its own PASS. Rule on this; I'll keep them separate if you prefer.
The integrator seat grant expired at 03:19 UTC, so an operator must re-enter it before I can run any integrator-gated command.
subject: #2727 round-1 fixes pushed: 6923d5e4e2 (F1-F3)
